- Dataset card: https://huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/Dolci-Instruct-SFT/blob/bd3c8f3a9b2cc5a9682e44b96ddd0bb2ff027221/README.md

R2AI downloads data on request during preparation and converts supported examples into prompt/target rows. It does not bundle the complete dataset or relicense it under the project's MIT License. Prepared manifests retain record IDs and dataset revision for attribution and reproducibility. See the upstream card for constituent data provenance and the data guide for filtering.
